title: Glazing Job & Order Management Software | Coglass
description: Track every glazing job from first enquiry to final paid invoice in one place — statuses, notes, photos, templates and never-reused order numbers. Your whole team on the same page.
lead: From the first enquiry to the final paid invoice, every job lives in one place your whole team can see — statuses, notes, site photos and history. No more "which spreadsheet was that on?"
steps_h2: One place for the whole job lifecycle
steps_sub: Coglass moves a job through every stage — and keeps everyone looking at the same record.
inc_h2: Everything a glazing job needs, attached
inc_sub: No more juggling spreadsheets, notebooks and group chats.
steps: Phone, email, your website enquiry form or your webshop — the customer, site address, contacts and job description go into a new order.
Send a quote or book a survey straight from the order. Everything stays attached to the same job.
Watch the job move through new request → survey → quote → on order → glass ready → fitting → completed, with the right label for collection, delivery or glazing.
Internal notes, site photos and documents live on the order so the whole team has the full picture — office and field.
Every order gets a unique, monotonic number that is never re-issued — even after a job is deleted — so your records stay clean.
When the job completes, raise the invoice, take payment and push to Xero — all from the same order.
included: Full order lifecycle
Statuses from enquiry to paid, with type-aware labels for collection, delivery and glazing jobs.
Order templates
Save common jobs as templates and spin up repeat work in seconds.
Never-reuse numbering
Monotonic order numbers that are never re-issued, even after deletion.
Soft-delete & trash
Delete to a trash bin, restore if needed, or purge — nothing lost by accident.
Site contacts & addresses
Multiple site and billing addresses with tap-to-call and map links.
Internal notes & photos
Thread notes and job photos against the order for the whole team.
“Needs attention”
Forgotten jobs sitting too long in a status are flagged automatically so nothing slips.
Quick Go
Build a quick walk-in order or quote in seconds for counter trade.
Documents
RAMS, quotes, invoices and job files all attached to the order.
Whole-team visibility
Office on the web, fitters on the app — one shared record that keeps itself in sync.
Linked extra jobs
Create a new linked job from site for the same customer, even offline.
Customer portal
Optional tokenised tracking, quote and invoice pages for your customers.
cta_h2: Run every job from one place
cta_p: Book a demo and we'll walk you through it on the kind of jobs you do — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
